prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Romanian woman, an adult, in her late 30s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy on top of an already immense frame. An immense mass of soft heavy fat already sits on her middle in heavy rounded folds — and rising from the top of that mass, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects even further forward, its taut round surface distinct from the looser folds beneath it, no waist at all anywhere. A gigantic bust resting above the belly, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm fair-olive skin, thick dark straight-edged brows, a heavy black liner smoked out at the outer corners, deep brown shadow blended up to the crease, long dense lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour, a deep red matte lip with a crisp edge, an intense, proud expression, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in low bun, real pores, real living eyes, 50 studs piercings set with a mix of diamonds, pearls and sapphires in bronze-toned metal, wearing a single piece of silver a bracelet. Full body fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 horizontal bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 27% of the way down her figure from the top, about 45% of the way down her figure from the top and about 63% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING DEEP EMERALD scale formations, VIVID JADE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries rich dark walnut wood fused directly into her own form, natural grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep warm-brown grain with VIVID honey-gold highlight streaks. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, chrysanthemum formations in DEEP GOLD and EMERALD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID MAGENTA scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
